about: Synthetic job-search inbox for the demo and the eval. Every company is fictional and every company domain uses the reserved .example TLD. ATS vendor domains are real because the matcher's shared-domain rule depends on them. 'day' is an offset from the moment the demo runs, so deadlines stay in the future. 'expect' is the hand label the eval scores against; where two answers are defensible, both are listed.
